results.title: Frequency column header sorts ascending then descending then back to no sort
results.error: Expected: "The Frequency header shows the ascending sort indicator" / "descending sort indicator". Observed: same double-arrow icon in all states (no direction indicator; only text colour changes), identical to the Name reference column.

steps.title: When the super admin clicks the Frequency column header a second time
steps.expected: The Frequency header shows the descending sort indicator

steps.title: Then the rows are sorted by frequency in descending order
steps.expected: All "One time" rows are listed before all "Daily" rows

steps.title: When the super admin clicks the Frequency column header a third time
steps.expected: The sort indicator is removed from the Frequency header

steps.title: Then the rows are back in the default order
steps.expected: The row order is the same as before the first click

steps.title: And the click cycle and indicators match the other sortable columns
steps.expected: Same three-state cycle and same indicator icons as the reference column

results.notes: Sort cycle verified on the active list (8 rows). Click 1: Daily x3 then One time x5 (ascending). Click 2: One time x5 then Daily x3 (descending). Click 3: back to the exact default order. Reference column Name: same 3-state cycle (asc, desc, default) and same indicator behaviour. Sort indicator: the header icon is the same up/down double-arrow in all 3 states for every column (Name included); only the header text darkens (text-slate-600 -> text-slate-900) when a sort is active; no aria-sort attribute. The CSV expects "the ascending sort indicator" / "the descending sort indicator": no direction-specific indicator exists anywhere in the table, so these 2 expected results cannot be literally confirmed -> PARTIAL. The AC3 part "exactly like the other sortable columns" is met. To decide with PO/QA: CSV wording vs UX gap (pre-existing, not specific to GEO-1172).

results.notes: Default Status = active only shows 8 orgs (1 page), so page 2 was reached with Status = all statuses (26 orgs, "Page 2 / 2 — 26 organisations", page size 20). Frequency filter sits right of the Status filter, options "all frequencies" / "daily" / "one time", "all frequencies" selected (lower-case labels, same style as the Status filter). Selecting daily from page 2: request page=0&size=20&frequency=DAILY (server-side), list shows 6 rows all "Daily" (NEW-ORG-2109, test 003, QA-NoLLM-Test-Org, QA-GEO, QA-ORG-1, Deloitte), result count "6 organisations" < 26. Reference count established independently BEFORE filtering by scanning both unfiltered pages (all statuses): 6 Daily, 5 One time, 15 "—" = 26 -> count matches. Not verifiable: the filtered result fits on one page (6 < 20), so "next pages of the filtered list" could not be exercised (CSV precondition "more DAILY organisations than one page holds" not met on staging) -> PARTIAL.
